description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of several language models across different evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis represents the categories: “BT-EVAL”, “KoBEST-BQ”, “KoBEST-CP”, “KoBEST-HS”, “KoBEST-SN”, and “AVG”, listed in that order. The vertical axis represents a value scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1, and is labeled as a performance score. Each category has a set of three adjacent bars representing the performance of “RedWhale (our)” in dark blue, “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” in medium blue, and “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” in light gray. For “BT-EVAL”, the “RedWhale (our)” bar reaches approximately 0.42, the “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” bar reaches approximately 0.52, and the “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” bar reaches approximately 0.56. For “AVG”, the “RedWhale (our)” bar reaches approximately 0.59, the “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” bar reaches approximately 0.61, and the “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” bar reaches approximately 0.96. The bars are grouped by category, with each group showing the performance of the three models. No bars are visually emphasized.
